topics.title: 课程作业与明确要求
topics.summary: 主讲教师必须明确说明是否允许使用生成式AI完成作业，并载明具体使用条件与范围。
topics.scope: 所有本科生与研究生课程及作业
topics.evidenceScope: All undergraduate and graduate courses and assignments

claims.text: Academic integrity guidance specifies that instructors must be explicit with their expectations about whether generative AI tools are permitted to complete assignments, quizzes, tests, or exams.

evidence.quote: Instructors must be explicit with their expectations about the use of GenAI to complete assignments, quizzes, tests or exams
evidence.title: Artificial Intelligence and ChatGPT | Academic Integrity

topics.title: 考试考核与具体条件
topics.summary: AVPA课程大纲范例包含一项示例：在课程具体条件下使用生成式AI，并提供记录、引用与说明；实际要求以教师的课程大纲为准。
topics.scope: 课程测验、期中考试、小测与期末考试
topics.evidenceScope: Course tests, midterms, quizzes, and final exams

claims.text: The AVPA model course outline includes an example permitting generative AI under specific conditions with documentation, citation and acknowledgement.

evidence.quote: may be used under specific conditions in this course with proper documentation, citation, and acknowledgement
evidence.title: UW Course Outline Suggestions: Generative AI
evidence.location: For instructors who permit use under certain conditions

topics.title: 使用声明与规范引用
topics.summary: 若任课教师在其课程大纲中采纳AVPA示范条款，学生使用AI时须提交包含具体工具使用说明、引注与致谢在内的记录。
topics.scope: 课业提交成果、报告与期末大作业
topics.evidenceScope: Coursework submissions, reports, and term projects

claims.text: AVPA sample course-outline language stipulates that when GenAI is permitted in class assignments, students must provide proper documentation, citation, and acknowledgement.

evidence.quote: may be used for assignments in this class with proper documentation, citation, and acknowledgement
evidence.title: UW Course Outline Suggestions: Generative AI
evidence.location: For instructors who permit generative AI use

topics.title: 学生作业与Policy 46保护
topics.summary: 指引建议不要将课程材料或学生作品上传到可能未经许可分享内容的不安全AI工具。
topics.scope: 课程资料、学生作业及Policy 46保密数据
topics.evidenceScope: Course materials, student work, and Policy 46 data

claims.text: Guidance says course materials and student work should not be uploaded to insecure AI tools that might share them without permission.

evidence.quote: Neither course materials nor student work should be uploaded to insecure AI tools that might share them without permission.
evidence.title: Applying UW Principles of AI Enablement to Teaching and Learning
evidence.location: Safe & fair use, data security principles

topics.title: 校内Copilot服务与访问
topics.summary: 保留的IST摘录指出，Microsoft Copilot可通过滑铁卢大学账号使用。
topics.evidenceScope: Campus Microsoft Copilot and IT-supported tools

claims.text: The retained IST excerpt says Microsoft Copilot is available through a UWaterloo account.

evidence.quote: Currently, Microsoft Copilot (formerly Bing Chat Enterprise), is available through your UWaterloo account.
evidence.title: Microsoft Copilot and artificial intelligence (AI) guidance

topics.title: 研究生科研与导师协商
topics.summary: 研究生应就生成式AI使用咨询导师，并在设有指导委员会时咨询该委员会。
topics.scope: 研究生论文、学位论文及科研项目
topics.evidenceScope: Graduate theses, dissertations, and research projects

claims.text: Graduate students should consult their supervisor or supervisors and their advisory committee, if one exists.

evidence.quote: graduate students should consult with their supervisor(s) and advisory committee (if one exists)
evidence.title: Generative AI guidance for graduate students and supervisors
evidence.location: Guidance for graduate students and supervisors, consultation rule

additionalTopics.scope: Policy 71学生学术处分审查程序

claims.text: Academic integrity guidance says it is important for instructors to be explicit about whether AI tools are allowed for assignments, tests or exams.

additionalTopics.title: 信息安全与风险评估审查
additionalTopics.summary: 处理大学数据的校级AI系统须经过信息风险评估（IRA）并获数据管护者批准，以控制安全与隐私风险。

additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Enterprise software deployment and IRA/PIA review

claims.text: IST review processes ensure that any AI tool used with University data is assessed for security, privacy, and contractual risks prior to institutional deployment.

evidence.title: Responsible Use of AI Tools with University Data | IST
